name: Smart Money Alert v1

webhooks.demo: /webhook/smart-money/demo/<redacted>  (POST {} - fires one realistic sample alert, tagged DEMO, bypasses dedupe)

pipeline.name: Alchemy Webhook
pipeline.notes: POST, rawBody on, respond 200 immediately, ROTATED secret path

pipeline.name: Config
pipeline.notes: SIGNING_KEY, TELEGRAM_*, LLM_*, USE_LLM, SYMBOL_MAP, WATCHLIST(8), GLOBAL_MIN_USD

pipeline.name: Route Demo?
pipeline.notes: Alchemy Webhook executed ? real path : demo path

pipeline.name: Verify Signature
pipeline.notes: pure-JS SHA256+HMAC over raw body (base64 from binary.data), constant-time compare, silent drop on fail

pipeline.name: Parse Activities
pipeline.notes: groups legs by txHash; QUOTE={ETH,WETH,USDC,USDT,DAI}; BUY=spendQuote+recvToken, SELL=spendToken+recvQuote; drops airdrops/self-transfers/stable-swaps/wraps/dust(<$1 legs); counterparty must be in 10-address router+pool allowlist

pipeline.name: Demo Fixture
pipeline.notes: synthetic BUY 420 WETH of unlisted SHAKA, demo:true (bypasses dedupe, message tagged DEMO)

pipeline.name: CoinGecko Prices
pipeline.notes: batched simple/price; retry 2; on error continue

pipeline.name: Gate Dedupe Compose
pipeline.notes: values trades by quote leg (stables $1, ETH/WETH x cached price w/ stale fallback marked ~); token-price only as fallback; $100K gate (per-wallet overrides); 24h dedupe (skipped for demo); builds MarkdownV2 head/value/footer + inline buttons (Dexscreener/Etherscan/Arkham) + facts for LLM

pipeline.name: AI Brain
pipeline.notes: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions, facts-only system prompt, 12s timeout, on error continue

pipeline.name: Pick Message
pipeline.notes: uses AI sentence if valid (mentions token, <=400 chars) else fallback line; MarkdownV2-escapes everything

pipeline.name: Telegram Send
pipeline.notes: sendMessage parse_mode MarkdownV2 + reply_markup buttons; retry 5 x 2s (harder than everything else)
